violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW SEAFOOD STORED ABOVE PREPARED VEGETABLES AND SAUCES IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REORGANIZED FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: SUSHI OHAYO ROLLS AT 51F AND BREADED SHRIMP AT 52F STORED ABOVE THE COOLING RIM IN ATOSA 2 DOOR PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO PLACE INSIDE PREP TOP FOR RAPID COOLING TO 41F. PLEASE ENSURE FOODS ARE STORED IN FOOD PANS PLACED DIRECTLY IN THE PREP TOP OR IN THE REACH IN AREA.

out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: No Bare Hand Contact with RTE Foods
violations.observation: Food employee(s) was observed handling the following ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands: EMPLOYEE HANDLING RAW SUSHI FISH WITHOUT GLOVES IN SUSHI STATION.
violations.corrective_action: Except when washing fruits and vegetables, food employees may not contact ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands. Employees shall be using suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, or clean disposable gloves to handle all ready-to-eat foods. Proper handling of food and effective handwashing procedures will help prevent foodborne illness. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO WASH HANDS AND WEAR GLOVES. PLEASE ENSURE EMPLOYEES COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: CREAM CHEESE MIX PREPARED 2 DAYS PRIOR.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC APPLIED DATE MARKED LABEL DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the BASE OF KITCHEN BACK DOOR.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE REPLACE DAMAGED DOOR SWEEP AT BASE OF KITCHEN DOOR.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counters IN SUSHI STATION AND BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC PREPARED SANITIZER BUCKETS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: ATOSA 3 DOOR UNDER COUNTER UNIT AT 48F; DISPLAY-LEFT AT 44F AND DISPLAY-MIDDLE AT 44F ALL IN SUSHI STATION.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC RELOCATED TCS FOODS FROM ATOSA 3 DOOR FLAT TOP DURING INSPECTION. UNSOLD/UNUSED FOODS IN DISPLAY UNITS ARE TO BE DISCARDED AT 2:00 PM. DO NOT STORE TCS FOODS IN UNITS UNTIL REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN FOOD TEMPERATURES AT 41F OR BELOW.

violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed food employees using improper handwashing procedures. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE WASHING GLOVED HANDS AT HANDWASH SINK NEAR COOK LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO REMOVE AND DISCARD GLOVES; WASH, RINSE AND DRY HANDS BEFORE PUTTING ON CLEAN GLOVES. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: OBSERVED SEVERAL PACKS OF VARIETY OF FISH (SALMON, TUNA, YELLOW TAIL, ESCOLAR AND TILAPIA) IN SEALED REDUCED OXYGEN PACKAGING (ROP) THAWING IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO HAVE ALL ROP FISH BE REMOVED FROM PACKAGING OR PACKAGING SLIT OPEN ONCE REMOVED FROM FREEZER TO THAW.
